purpose: Provide a separate explicit gate for deciding whether to execute NEXT3 as a methodological identifiability study.
scope_if_authorized: Test implementation and fixture identifiability properties.
Verify deterministic reconstruction and mapping traceability.
Verify the declared null and predecision information boundary.
explicitly_out_of_scope: Value, utility, reward, performance, quality or success effects.
Selection of a statistically sufficient replication count.
execution_constraints: Use only frozen design and implementation artifacts.
No post-hoc modification of acceptance criteria.
No scientific interpretation beyond the predefined methodological criteria.
Record complete provenance and hashes for all executed artifacts.
required_authorization: An explicit decision must be recorded before any methodological execution is performed.
